description: Mohammed Amin Adoul publishes a Python classification workflow and extracted vibration features from a full-scale outdoor railway-switch test facility. The June 2026 deposit lists 801 one-second segments representing 267 physical events, with sixteen features and normal, joint, squat or crossing labels. Public downloads include the pipeline, reference results and environment requirements. The included LICENSE states MIT, while Zenodo’s metadata state CC BY 4.0; this discrepancy is preserved. The workflow can benchmark condition-state recognition used in maintenance simulations. Raw vibration signals require a separate request, and site location, recording dates and transfer uncertainty are not established. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this package. The README expects the CSV in a data subdirectory, although Zenodo lists it at the root. No files were downloaded or executed, and leakage-free performance claims were not audited.
